name: Bustem BDR call operations
purpose: Keep completed calls, rep reviewed outcomes, HubSpot activities, and Oliver's daily report in sync.

sources.recording: Parley local MCP or an approved dialer recording feed
sources.contact: BDR verified email or HubSpot contact ID
sources.dialCount: Separate dialer or CRM activity feed, not recording count

steps.when: A finished Bustem recording is imported
steps.action: Send to Make as soon as the finished recording is available
Match an existing HubSpot contact using a verified ID or email; otherwise hold for review
doNotInfer: decision maker from job title alone

steps.when: A verified HubSpot contact is matched
steps.action: Create a HubSpot call activity and save its ID against callId
Update the HubSpot call and create a follow up task if required

steps.when: 18:00 Johannesburg time while the server is running
steps.action: Make sends Oliver the daily report through an approved destination
excludes: dial count without a dialer feed

duplicateRule: Store eventId in Make before creating a HubSpot activity or sending a report. A retry must not repeat the action.
